newsitem.title: USA: Perfumania July same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Perfumania July same-store sales down.

text.p: Perfumania Inc Thursday said that July retail sales totalled $8,737,589, a 20.6 percent increase over the year ago's $7,245,137, but comparable store sales fell 2.7 percent.

For the second quarter, total retail sales were $28,857,368, a 26.8 percent increase over retail sales in the second quarter of 1996 of $22,763,086. Comparable store sales for the second quarter rose 1.9 percent when compared with the second quarter last year.
Perfumania is a specialty retailer and wholesale distributor of a wide range of brand name and designer fragrances and related products.
